ओ: ओ 1. ओ, the vowel ओ, the thirteenth letter of the alphabet. —ओ-कार, अस्, m. the letter or sound ओ।
ओ 2. ओ, ind. a vocative particle, Oh; an interjection of calling, Ho, Holla; of reminiscence, Ho, Ah; of compassion, Ah, Oh.
ओ 3. ओ, औस्, m. a N. of Brahmā.
ओ 4. ओ (आ-उ), only occurring in the past pass. part. —१। ओत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. invoked, summoned.
ओक: ओक ओक, अस्, m. (fr. rt. उच्), a house; an asylum, a refuge (see ओकस् below); a bird?; [cf. Lith. ûkis, ‘a dwelling;’ ûkininkas: Gr. οἶκος belongs to rt. विश्।]
ओकस्: ओकस्, अस्, n. gratification, pleasure; place of hap-piness or pleasure, a resting-place, a home, house; an asylum, a refuge.
ओकिवस्: ओकिवस्, आन् (irreg. perf. part. Par. ?), Ved. delighting in anything; (Sāy.) meeting together, united.
ओक्य: ओक्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. favourable to the (inmates of a) house; good for a house, kind to a household; (अम्), n. gratification, pleasure; a comfortable place; a resting-place, a house.
ओकण: ओकण ओकण, अस्, or ओकणि, इस्, m. a bug. See ओकोदनी।
ओकुल: ओकुल ओकुल, अस्, m. a cake of flour.
ओकोदनी: ओकोदनी ओकोदनी or ओक्कणी, f. a bug. See ओकण।
ओक्ष्: ओक्ष् ओक्ष् (आ-उक्ष्), cl. 1. P. ओक्षति, -षि-तुम्, to sprinkle over or upon.
ओख्: ओख् ओख्, cl. 1. P. ओखति, ओखाञ्-चकार, ओखितुम्, to be dry or arid; to be able or competent; to adorn, suffice; to refuse, prevent, ward off: Caus. ओखयति, -यितुम्: Desid. ओचिखिषति।
ओगण: ओगण ओगण, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. अव-गण?), Ved. repudiated by one's companions, solitary, de-spised; (Sāy.) collected, united.
ओगीयस्: ओगीयस् ओगीयस् = ओजीयस्, comparative of उग्र, q. v.
ओघ: ओघ ओघ, अस्, m. (fr. rt. वह्), flood, stream; a torrent, a rapid flow of water, an inunda-tion; a heap or quantity, flock, multitude, abundance; the whole; quick time in music; tradition, traditional advice or instruction; [cf. Gr. ὄχλος?]. —ओघ-रथ, अस्, m., N. of a son of Oghavat and brother of Ogha-vatī. —ओघ-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having a strong stream; (आन्), m., N. of a prince, father-in-law or brother-in-law of Sudarśana; (ती), f., N. of a daughter of Ogha-vat; N. of the river Sarasvatī.
ओज्: ओज् ओज् (connected with ओजस् below), cl. 1. 10. P. ओजति, ओजितुम्, or ओजयति, यितुम्, to be strong or able; to increase, to have vital power.
ओज: ओज ओज, अस्, आ, अम्, odd (as the first, third, fifth, &c., in a series).
ओजस्: ओजस् ओजस्, अस्, n. (fr. उज् = वज्; see उग्र), bodily strength, vigour, energy, ability; vitality, the principle of vital warmth and action diffused through-out the body; virility, the generative faculty; support, stay; (in rhetoric) a form of style, elaborate style, abounding with compounds; (in astrology) each alternate sign of the zodiac (as the first, third, fifth, &c.); water; light, splendor; metallic lustre; manifestation, appearance; ओजसा, with strength, resolutely, energetically (sometimes used at the be-ginning of a compound, e. g. ओजसा-कृत, done ener-getically); [cf. अमितौजस्, उत्तमौजस्, &c.: cf. also Gr. ὑγιής Zend auṣo; Hib. og, ‘young, juvenile, fresh;’ oig, ‘a champion;’ oighe, ‘entireness, virginity.’] —ओजस्-तर, अस्, आ, अम् (comparative), more strong. —ओजस्-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, or ओजस्-विन्, ई, इनी, इ, vigorous, powerful, strong, energetic; splendid, bright. —ओजस्वि-ता, f. strength, power. —ओजो-दा, आस्, आस्, अम्, Ved. granting power, strengthening, possessed of strength. —ओज-बला, f. (with Buddhists) N. of a goddess of Bodhidruma.
ओजसीन: ओजसीन, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. showing strength, powerful.
ओजस्य: ओजस्य, अस्, आ, अम्, showing strength, powerful.
ओजाय: ओजाय, nom. A. ओजायते, -यितुम्, to exhibit strength or energy, to make effort; to be strong.
ओजिष्ठ: ओजिष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम् (regarded as superlative उग्र, q. v.), strongest, most vigorous or vehement.
ओजीयस्: ओजीयस्, आन्, असी, अस् (regarded as comparative of उग्र, q. v.), stronger, more vigorous or vehement.
ओज्मन्: ओज्मन्, आ, m., Ved. strength; (Sāy.) speed; an instigator.
ओड: ओड ओड, अस्, m., N. of a minister of Pra-tāpāditya.
ओडक: ओडक ओडक or ओडव, अस्, m. a musical mode which omits two of the notes of the scale, Ṛ and Pa.
ओडिका: ओडिका ओडिका or ओडी, f. wild rice.
ओड्र: ओड्र ओड्र, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people and country, the northern part of Orissa; (अस्), m. the China rose. —ओड्र-पुष्प, अम्, n. Hibiscus Rosa Sinensis, and its flowers. —ओड्राख्या (°र-आख्°), f. the China rose.
ओढ: ओढ ओढ, अस्, आ, अम् (past pass. part. of आ-वह्, q. v.), brought or carried near.
ओण्: ओण् ओण्, cl. 1. P. ओणति, ओणाञ्-चकार, ओणितुम्, to remove, take away, drag along: Caus. ओणयति, -यितुम्, औणिणत्: Desid. औणिणिषति।
ओणि: ओणि ओणि, इस्, m. or f. (generally in du. ई; said to be fr. preceding rt.), Ved. a vessel used in the preparation of the Soma juice, and said to consist of two pieces (?), heaven and earth; preserving power; protection.
ओत: ओत 2. ओत, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. वे with आ), woven, sewn with the threads across; [cf. प्रोत।] —ओत-प्रोत, अस्, आ, अम्, sewn crosswise and length-wise, extending to every quarter?; (अम्), ind. cross-wise and lengthwise, vertically and horizontally.
ओतु: ओतु, उस्, m. the woof or cross-threads of a web; (उस्), m. f. a cat, (in this sense said to be fr. rt. अव्।) In a compound a final अ preceding may optionally be dropped (e. g. स्थूलोतु or स्थूलौतु, a fat cat.)
ओत्स: ओत्स ओत्स, अस्, m., N. of an Agrahāra.
ओदती: ओदती ओदती, f. (part. of rt. 2. उद्), Ved. flowing forth, issuing out, rising upwards; epithet of the dawn.
ओदन: ओदन, अस्, अम्, m. n. grain mashed and cooked with milk, boiled rice; a cloud; (नी), f. the plant Sida Cordifolia. When a name is given to a pupil to indicate his attachment to any particular master, ओदन may be prefixed to denote that the pupil's object is rather food than instruction (e. g. ओदन-पाणिनीयः, a pupil of Pāṇini whose object is only to be fed by Pāṇini). —ओदनाह्वया (°न-आह्°) or ओदनाह्वा or ओदनिका, f., N. of a plant.
ओदनीय: ओदनीय, nom. P. ओदनीयति, -यितुम्, to wish to make mashed food of anything.
ओद्म: ओद्म, अस्, m. or ओद्मन्, अ, n. flowing, flooding; wetting, moistening.
ओधस्: ओधस् ओधस्, अस्, n. an udder; = ऊधस्।
ओपश: ओपश ओपश, अस्, m. (fr. rt. पश् ?), Ved. an ornament of the head, lock of hair, curl; tuft of hair ?; (Sāy.) a horn (fr. उप-शी with आ).
ओपशिन्: ओपशिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. adorned with curls.
ओम्: ओम् ॐ, ind. (said to be fr. rt. अव्; perhaps originally ॐ, which may be derived fr. आं, and this fr. आ), a word of solemn affirmation and respectful assent (sometimes translated by yes, verily, so be it, and in this sense compared with Amen). It is placed at the commencement of most Hindū works, and as a sacred exclamation may be uttered (but not so as to be heard by ears profane) at the beginning and end of a reading of the Vedas or previously to any prayer. It is also regarded as a particle of auspicious salutation (Hail!). ॐ appears first in the Upani-shads as a mystic monosyllable, and is there set forth as the object of profound religious meditation, the highest spiritual efficacy being attributed not only to the whole word but also to the three sounds अ, उ, म्, of which it consists. In later times ॐ is the mystic name for the Hindū triad, and represents the union of the three gods, viz. अ (Viṣṇu), उ (Śiva), म् (Brahmā). It may also be typical of the three Vedas. ॐ is usually called प्रणव, more rarely अक्षरम् or एकाक्षरम्, and only in later times ॐ-कार। The Buddhists use ॐ at the commencement of their विद्या षड्-अक्षरी or mystical formulary in six syllables (viz. ॐ मानि पद्मे हूं). Lexico-graphers affirm that besides the above uses, ॐ may imply command or injunction, removal or warding off (Away! Hence!), and be used as an inceptive par-ticle. Grammarians assert that before ॐ a preced-ing अ or आ at the end of a word should be cut off (e. g. विजयोङ्कारः for विजयौङ्कारः (°य-ओङ्°), thanksgiving for victory; see Gram. 38. b). —ॐ-कार, अस्, m. the sacred and mystical syllable ॐ; the ex-clamation ॐ; pronouncing the syllable ॐ; (आ), f. a Buddhist Śakti or female personification of divine energy. —ओंकार-ग्रन्थ, अस्, m. title of a work of Nārāyaṇa. —ओंकार-तीर्थ, N. of a Tīrtha. —ओंकार-भट्ट, अस्, m., N. of a man.
ओम: ओम ओम, अस्, m. (fr. rt. अव्, cf. 4. ऊ), Ved. a protector; any one favourably disposed (towards another); any one worthy of favour or protection.
ओमन्: ओमन्, आ, m., Ved. protection, assistance; favour, kindness; a kind person. —ओमन्-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. friendly, agreeable; favourable, kind; satiating.
ओमात्रा: ओमात्रा, f., Ved. protection, assistance, kindness, readiness to help.
ओम्या: ओम्या, f., Ved. favour, protection. —ओम्या-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. friendly, favourable.
ओमिल: ओमिल ओमिल, अस्, m., N. of a man.
ओरिमिका: ओरिमिका ओरिमिका, f. title of a section of the Kāṭhaka Recension of the Yajur-veda.
ओर्णु: ओर्णु ओर्णु (आ-ऊर्णु), cl. 2. P. A. ओर्णोति or -णौति, -णुते, -णवितुम् or -णुवितुम्, to cover.
ओल: ओल ओल or ओल्ल, अस्, आ, अम्, wet, damp; (अस्), m. an esculent root, Arum Campanulatum.
ओलण्ड्: ओलण्ड् ओलण्ड्, cl. 10. P. ओलण्डयति, यितुम्, to cast upwards, throw up; (various readings have ओलज् and ओल्ज्।)
ओशिष्ठहन्: ओशिष्ठहन् ओशिष्ठ-हन्, आ, घ्नी, अ (fr. ओशि-ष्ठ = ओषिष्ठ and हन्), Ved. striking very quickly; [cf. ओषिष्ठ-दावन्।]
ओष: ओष ओष, अस्, m. (fr. 1. उष्), burning, combustion; [cf. Goth. azgô; Angl. Sax. asca; Old Germ. asga; Mod. Germ. asche; Eng. ashes.]
ओषण: ओषण, अस्, m. pungency, biting or pungent taste, sharp flavour; (ई), f. a pot-herb, commonly called Pūrya.
ओषधि: ओषधि ओषधि, इस्, or ई, f. (a contraction fr. अवस and धि, ‘containing refreshment or food?;’ according to Pāṇini VI. 3. 132, the form in ई is only used for the oblique cases in the Veda; but this re-striction does not seem to be universal), a herb, a plant, medicinal plant; an annual plant or herb, one that dies after becoming ripe. —ओषधि-गर्भ, अस्, m. the moon (as containing the herbs in its interior). —ओषधि-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. born or living among herbs; produced from plants. —ओषधि-पति, इस्, m. a physician (master of the medicinal plants); the moon. —ओषधि-प्रस्थ, अस्, m., N. of a mythic town, the town of Himavat. —ओषधी-पति, इस्, m. the moon. —ओषधी-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. connected with herbs. —ओषधीश (°धि-ईश), अस्, m. the moon (presiding over the plants). —ओष-धी-संशित, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. impelled or influ-enced by herbs. —ओषधी-सूक्त, अम्, n., N. of a hymn.
ओषम्: ओषम् ओषम्, ind. (fr. rt. 1. उष् ?), Ved. quickly, immediately.
ओषिष्ठदावन्: ओषिष्ठ-दावन्, आ, आ, अ, Ved. giving very quickly.
ओष्ठ: ओष्ठ ओष्ठ, अस्, m. (contracted fr. अव-स्थ), the down-hanging lip, i. e. the upper lip (op-posed to अधर), a lip in general; ओष्ठौ or द्वाव् ओष्ठौ, du. the lips, the two lips; (ई), f. a creeper bearing a red flower, to which the lip is com-monly compared (Coccinia Grandis); [cf. बिम्ब: cf. also Slav. ûsta, neut. pl.; ûstna, f.: Lat. ostium.] In compounds a final अ or आ before ओष्ठ may be optionally dropped (e. g. बिम्ब + ओष्ठ becomes either बिम्बोष्ठ or बिम्बौष्ठ, ‘red-lipped,’ and the fem. of the comp. adj. may be formed in आ or ई). —ओष्ठ-कर्णक, आस्, m. pl., N. of a fabu-lous race who have their ears and lips very near each other. —ओष्ठ-कोप or ओष्ठ-प्रकोप, अस्, m. a disease of the lips. —ओष्ठ-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, produced by the lips, labial. —ओष्ठ-जाह, अम्, n. the root of the ear. —ओष्ठ-पल्लव, अम्, n. a lip or the lips. —ओष्ठ-पुट, अम्, n. the cavity made by opening the lips. —ओष्ठ-पुष्प, अम्, n. the plant Pentaptera Tomentosa. —ओष्ठ-रोग, अस्, m. any morbid affection of the lips. —ओष्ठाधर (°ठ-अध्°), औ, du. or अम्, n. the upper and lower lip. —ओष्ठोपम-फला (°ठ-उपमा-फ्°), f. the creeper Bryonia Grandis, whose flower resembles a lip.
ओष्ठक: ओष्ठक (at the end of compounds) = ओष्ठ; (अस्, आ, अम्), taking care of the lips.
ओष्ठ्य: ओष्ठ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, being at the lips; belonging to or fit for the lips, labial (as the sounds उ, ऊ, ओ, औ, प्, फ्, ब्, भ्, म्, व्, and the Upadhmānīya). —ओष्-ठ्य-योनि, इस्, इस्, इ, produced from labial sounds. —ओष्ठ्य-स्थान, अस्, आ, अम्, pronounced with the lips, as ओ and औ।
ओष्ण: ओष्ण ओष्ण, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. आ, implying di-minution, and उष्ण), a little warm, tepid.
ओह्: ओह् ओह् (rt. 2. ऊह् with आ), cl. 1. A. ओहते, हितुम्, to understand, admit, receive.
ओह: ओह, अस्, m. (fr. 2. ऊह्), Ved. meditation; (Sāy.) bringing, performing; reaching. —ओह-ब्रह्मन्, आ, m., Ved. really a Brāhman, a Brāhman valued as one; (Sāy.) one who has sacred knowledge.
ओहल: ओहल, अस्, m., N. of a man.
ओहस्: ओहस्, अस्, n., Ved. idea, true notion; (Sāy.) praise.
ओहान: ओहान, अस्, आ, अम्, considering, reflecting on.
ओत्सूर्यम्: ओत्सूर्यम् (आ-उत्°), ind. until the sun rises.
